criteria.name: Product specificity
criteria.notes: Official workflow supports first-frame image and reference-video conditioning plus camera pose; exact ASIN preservation is untested.

criteria.name: Output quality
criteria.notes: Vendor WBench results and demos are not AIVP hands-on quality evidence; comparison uses different prompts/poses and selected seed.

criteria.name: Control and consistency
criteria.notes: Camera-motion and instruction adherence are the stated optimization target; three-run repeatability is untested.

criteria.name: Workflow strength
criteria.notes: CLI modes and settings are documented, but the workflow requires large separate weights, a depth backend and specialist accelerator setup.

criteria.name: Speed and reliability
criteria.notes: No AIVP timing, creator-hardware render or failure-rate evidence.

criteria.name: Cost efficiency
criteria.notes: Weights are publicly downloadable, but compatible compute, energy and cost per accepted output are unmeasured.

criteria.name: Commercial rights
criteria.notes: Resolved failure for monetized AIVP use: required ViGeo checkpoint is CC BY-NC 4.0 even though Turbo/base are Apache-2.0.

criteria.name: Automation and integration
criteria.notes: Deterministic shell launchers and modes are documented; no audited AIVP API/MCP integration exists.

criteria.name: AU creator/SMB fit
criteria.notes: Ungated files are geographically accessible, but roughly 79.7GiB minimum assets and specialist GPU requirements are poor indie-creator fit.

criteria.name: Monetization fit
criteria.notes: No affiliate programme found, and current required dependency blocks monetized output.

analysis: A relevant control-focused model variant with public weights, but it is not a hosted creator tool. No AIVP run exists; exact-product quality, reliability and economics are unknown; and required ViGeo is noncommercial.
confidence_notes: Primary official repository, model, dependency and project-page evidence only; no hands-on artifacts.

hard_gates.product_affiliate: Blocked pending three-run first-10-seconds exact-product success.
hard_gates.publication: Blocked because required ViGeo is CC BY-NC 4.0 and no hands-on evidence exists.
hard_gates.integration: Blocked by storage, absent NVIDIA accelerator, unresolved commercial rights and unaudited runtime.
